🌴 LAST CALL FOR MEXICO 🌴  
  
What if you started 2027 somewhere that made it easy to slow down, breathe deeply, and reconnect with what matters?  
  
Join Jennifer Cavalieri & Leah Kleiner for a New Year Reset Retreat at Mar de Jade in coastal Mexico, January 3-9, 2027.  
  
Seven days of yoga, meditation, reflection, nourishing food, ocean time, jungle views, meaningful connection, and plenty of space to simply be. [...] Set your intentions. Clear some space. Move into the new year feeling grounded, refreshed, and inspired.  
  
✨ 6 nights / 7 days  
✨ Daily yoga + meditation  
✨ Farm-to-table meals  
✨ Intention-setting workshop  
✨ Boat + snorkel excursion  
✨ Evening restorative practices  
✨ Plenty of time to explore, relax, and enjoy the beach  
  
If 2027 is calling you to slow down and reset, this is your invitation. 🌊
